items.statement: The independent investigation retains the specified neutral singlet connectivity and explicitly validates the two labeled nitrate Ir-O bonds.
items.expected: A reproducible record identifies Ir1, Cl1/Cl2, P1/P2, N1, O1/O2/O3 and preserves the specified O1-Ir1/O2-Ir1 connectivity.

items.statement: The selected geometry is advanced only with explicit optimization and vibrational validation, with coverage and stopping rationale recorded.
items.expected: The report contains convergence/stationary-point evidence, imaginary-frequency handling, and a reproducible account of starting structures or bounded failure.

items.statement: The computed molecular geometry supports a pseudo-octahedral structure with bidentate nitrate and a narrow O-Ir-O bite angle.
items.expected: The reported Ir-O/N-O distances and O1-Ir1-O2 angle are chemically consistent with the source crystallographic structure.

items.statement: Nitrate-associated calculated modes provide a coherent comparison with the measured IR pattern, subject to harmonic and condensed-phase limitations.
items.expected: The report gives mode assignments, frequencies, comparison logic and limitations rather than an unsupported exact match claim.
